title: Reactivation of Suspended Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts
content:
**Customer Care desk card.** A suspended Ship-To Fulfillment Account takes no orders. It is reactivated by the agent at the customer's request, provided the customer's Commercial Credit Account status is active; the reactivation brings the delivery location back to active status at the service level it holds on reactivation.

### The credit account condition

The customer's Commercial Credit Account status is read from its system record: reactivation is available when that status is active.

### The tool: `reactivate_ship_to_971b9440`

**Capability.** Reactivates one suspended Ship-To Fulfillment Account at the customer's request. The call sets the delivery location's status to active, so it takes orders again, and sets the service level it holds on reactivation to the level supplied; its order history, returns, dates and programs are left unchanged. Once stored, the ship-to lookup shows the location as active at that level.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reactivate_ship_to_971b9440` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ship_to_id` | the internal identifier of the suspended ship-to (delivery location) to reactivate, as returned by the ship-to account lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `variant_name` | the service level the location holds on reactivation | exactly one of: Corbett Parcel Ship-To; Corbett Standard Ship-To; Corbett Priority Ship-To; Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To; Corbett Premier Route Ship-To; Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To |

Each level is spelled exactly as listed: Corbett Parcel Ship-To when the location is to hold the parcel level, Corbett Standard Ship-To for the standard level, Corbett Priority Ship-To for the priority level, Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To for the route delivery level, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To for the premier route level and Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To for the dedicated delivery level.

**Return.** A dictionary receipt: `status` is the word reactivated when the change was stored; `ship_to_id` is the location reactivated; `ship_to_status` is its lifecycle status now, the word active; `variant_name` is the service level it now holds, spelled as supplied.

### What changes on the records

| Item on the ship-to | After the call |
|---|---|
| status | active |
| service level | the level supplied |
| order history, returns, dates, programs | unchanged |
